fields.state: each entry flips a tracked value; scope says when it flips back (a beat range) or 'permanent'
fields.effects: emitter, radiance, grain, boil, plus world-specific passes

fields.register: the acting register of the beat (D88); planner default 2026-10-17, provisional until the owner edits the edit sheet
fields.light_pushes: the feeling the light drives (D91); blocking and poses are composed to support it
